attestations.text: A-kuei 阿桂 (T. 廣庭, H. 雲巖), Sept. 7, 1717–1797, Oct. 10, official and general, was a member of the Chang-chia 章佳 clan and of the Manchu Plain Blue Banner. He was the only son of A-k'o-tun [q. v.] and for a time (1736) studied under Shên T'ung [q. v.].

westernYears.note: Western year as printed; not a resolved Chinese civil year.
Western year as printed; not a resolved Chinese civil year.

accounts.evidence: 阿桂，字廣庭，章佳氏。初為滿洲正藍旗人，以阿桂平回部駐伊犁治事有勞，改隸正白旗。父大學士阿克敦，自有傳。
